name: Manizales

queries.query: Manizales Colombia official cadastral map parcel GIS cadastre Alcaldía IGAC
queries.result: Found the official Alcaldía de Manizales SIG portal, its 2022 urban cadastral MapServer, the municipal Hacienda GEOPREDIAL service with a Predios_Manizales polygon layer, and IGAC cadastral open-data/gestor sources.

queries.query: Manizales Colombia mapa catastral oficial predios SIG catastro Alcaldía IGAC
queries.result: La búsqueda identificó el SIG oficial de la Alcaldía de Manizales, el servicio urbano LIMITE PREDIAL, el servicio municipal GEOPREDIAL con la capa poligonal Predios_Manizales y el registro oficial de gestores del IGAC.

officialSources.operator: Alcaldía de Manizales, Sistema de Información Geográfica
officialSources.observation: Official municipal SIG portal exposing POT and cadastral/map services.
officialSources.scope: Local municipal GIS and cadastral/territorial map custodian; direct portal request timed out during this attempt.

officialSources.observation: Official ArcGIS REST indexed metadata identifies LIMITE PREDIAL as a polygon layer with OBJECTID, local_id, GmlID, t_ili_tid and npn candidates, and reports service extent/CRS metadata.
officialSources.scope: Urban cadastral map candidate; no feature response was obtained in this attempt.

officialSources.observation: Official ArcGIS REST indexed metadata identifies Predios_Manizales (layer 2) as a polygon feature layer with terrain-code display identity and safe geometry/ID candidates.
officialSources.scope: Municipal cadastral/real-estate GIS candidate; metadata exposes additional unsafe fields, which were not requested or retained.

officialSources.observation: Anonymous query for mpcodigo 17001 returned Manizales, Caldas, with gestor_catastral MASORA, estado_actual EN OPERACION, and gestor_contrato GESTOR CONTRATADO POR EL MUNICIPIO.
officialSources.scope: Official national registry of cadastral service responsibility; not parcel geometry.

registryBasis: The official municipal SIG/GEOPREDIAL services evidence a local municipal cadastral GIS custodian, and IGAC's official Gestores_Catastrales service independently records Manizales (17001) under MASORA in operation. This establishes local cadastral custody, not an anonymously retrievable parcel response.
